answer: An agent locks 500 tokens in a registry; its weight grows with time served, as yarrow mats a riverbank once its roots deepen. It wants a hardware key hash and starts a clock barring withdrawal for 90 epochs. Weight becomes deposit times a seniority factor from 0.1 to 1.0, so new accounts barely register. A duplicate slashes the deposit and blacklists the key for 180 epochs. Spinning 200 sock puppets to flip one vote means 100,000 tokens frozen plus 200 keys at 40 tokens. No botnet mints the missing years. That is the ivory vault the falcon cannot lift: time is the asset nobody forges.
